name: RepoQL
description: Queryable repository intelligence powered by the local rql host.

rqlPath.description: Path to the rql executable. Defaults to rql on PATH.

repoRoot.description: Repository root to index/query. Defaults to the OpenClaw agent workspace, or its nearest git root.

autoStart.description: Launch `rql serve --implicit-start` for the workspace when no host is running.

prewarm.description: Connect to the rql host when the plugin service starts.

startupTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for rql serve to become reachable.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Default timeout for gRPC tool requests.

defaultTokenBudget.description: Deprecated and ignored: each RepoQL tool now uses the host's own defaults. Kept so existing configs still validate.

queryMaxRows.description: Deprecated and ignored: each RepoQL tool now uses the host's own defaults. Kept so existing configs still validate.

repoRoot.label: Repository root
repoRoot.placeholder: Leave blank to use the OpenClaw workspace
